page.layout: One printed page: title page, all lines centred in one column; a printed ornament (fleuron) below the central lines. No running head, no page number, no notes in the margins. A left-edge strip of an adjacent page is not transcribed.
page.notes: Printed ornament (fleuron) between the editor's line and the place line; not text. The left edge shows fragments of an adjacent page and a binding, not transcribed. "Samosateniani" is printed "Samosatteniani" in the scan as read; "Basileensis" is printed "Basileensis" with long-s forms rendered as plain s. The word "De" on the line after "Samosateniani" is set in a larger italic style. Some letters in the Roman numerals are uncertain: "XXVIII" is read as printed; the final "I" may be a worn "I".
